narrator.rule: The narrator only says what the profile says. Every sentence can be traced to a section, a claim or the music/movement DNA.
narrator.identity: one narrator for the whole atlas: the same face and animation everywhere; a native-speaker voice of the same character per language (studio-grade); the viewer chooses the language

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: The dance is performed by pairs facing each other without holding hands, positioned with their backs turned to the neighboring pair to form a wider circle.
In the first part of the music, the circle rotates as the girls back up and the boys step forward toward them.
Both boys and girls raise their hands in the air and execute baby bouncing steps.
Watch for Bouncing Circle Advance, Embraced Waltz Spin.

scenes.title: Body and posture
narration: Upright with hands held raised in the air during the non-partnered phase, followed by a closed ballroom or social embrace.
Both dancers raise their hands in the air during the first part; arms transition into an embrace during the second part.

scenes.title: Step A — slowly
narration: Step 1: Form a circle of facing pairs without hand contact, backs turned to neighboring couples.
Step 2: Raise hands in the air.
Footwork from the sources: Baby bouncing steps during the circle rotation; waltz footwork during the spinning section.
Drill: Stand facing partner without touching, hands held high above head.
on_screen: Instructor front view, then back view (student's perspective); repetitions per step: about 4
Counts on screen

scenes.title: Step B — the next layer
narration: Step 3: Execute baby bouncing steps while rotating the circle, boys moving forward and girls backing up.
Step 4: Embrace partner at the start of the second musical part.
Drill: Practice baby bouncing steps traveling forward (leader) and backward (follower).
on_screen: Instructor front and back view; slow, then half tempo

scenes.title: Put it together
narration: Step A, then Step B, without stopping. Slow first.
Now half tempo. Now full tempo.
Mirror: the instructor faces you and mirrors, so your right is your right.
Drill: Synchronize the bouncing advance along the curve of a rotating circle.
on_screen: Split screen: front view / back view
Tempo label changes: slow → half → full

scenes.title: Common mistakes and what to avoid
narration: Avoid traveling away from the spot during the waltz spin; avoid dropping hands during the opening circle rotation.
on_screen: Side-by-side: source-supported correction

Options card: Seated or supported option: Perform seated facing a partner; lift arms overhead and bounce the heels or tap toes alternately forward and back, then lower arms to clasp hands and gently sway torso side to side in a waltz rhythm. · For children: Play 'Approach and Spin': children take tiny bunny hops toward and away from their partners with hands up like rabbit ears, then shout 'Embrace!' on the music change to link elbows and spin like tops.
